claims.claim: The Philadelphia 76ers announced a multi-year partnership with Kalshi and are the first NBA franchise to announce an official prediction-market partner, days after the NBA named Kalshi and Polymarket preferred prediction-market exchanges.

claims.claim: The NBA agreement gave Kalshi and Polymarket the right to use NBA logos, league data and broadcast advertising, and lets the NBA approve markets offered.

claims.source_title: Sixers become first NBA team to partner with a prediction market, team up with Kalshi amid growing gambling concerns
claims.supporting_quote: Monday’s NBA agreement with major prediction markets including Kalshi, which were already hosting NBA markets, gave them the right to use NBA logos, league data, and to advertise on NBA broadcasts, while allowing the NBA to approve the markets offered on the platform.

claims.claim: A 2005 American Economic Review internet experiment with more than 6,400 subjects, including 267 consultants, found that a flexible market price prevents herding, that contrarian behavior distorts prices, and that convergence to fundamental value is rare even after 20 decisions.
claims.episode_span: The flexible price prevented herding: people did not simply pile onto the last trade and ignore their own signal.
claims.source_title: Herding and Contrarian Behavior in Financial Markets: An Internet Experiment
claims.supporting_quote: We find that the presence of a flexible market price prevents herding.

claims.claim: A 2007 Journal of Finance study of more than 1,500 decisions found Chicago Board of Trade professionals were better able than students to discern the quality of public signals, and that professionals' decisions were not affected by the domain of earnings.
claims.episode_span: Analysis of over 1,500 individual decisions found that the professionals were better able to discern the quality of public signals
claims.source_title: Information Cascades: Evidence from a Field Experiment with Financial Market Professionals
claims.supporting_quote: Analysis of over 1,500 individual decisions suggests that CBOT professionals behave differently from our student control group.

claims.claim: A 2012 Management Science study of Prosper.com found rational herding: well-funded listings attract more funding after controls, poor credit grades amplify herding momentum, friend endorsements weaken it, and rational herding predicted loan performance better than irrational herding.
claims.episode_span: Well-funded borrower listings tended to attract more funding after the researchers controlled for unobserved listing heterogeneity and payoff externalities.
claims.source_title: Rational Herding in Microloan Markets
claims.supporting_quote: We find evidence of rational herding among lenders.

claims.claim: A 2018 Annals of Financial Economics paper using the CSAD method found herding in six major crypto-currencies and CCI30 from 07-08-2015 to 18-01-2018 in both up and down markets, with no significant volatility effect.
claims.episode_span: Herding showed up in both up and down markets, which the paper reads as over-enthusiasm and over-reaction.
claims.source_title: HERDING IN CRYPTO-CURRENCY MARKETS
claims.supporting_quote: Herding is found under up and down market activity, indicating over-enthusiasm and over-reaction.

claims.claim: A 2013 review in the Review of Behavioral Finance found substantial insight on investor herding but inconclusive evidence outside equity markets and a need for better empirical methods.
claims.episode_span: The review says relatively little is known for markets other than equity markets
claims.source_title: Herding in financial markets: a review of the literature
claims.supporting_quote: The discussion indicates that there are still open issues and areas with inconclusive evidence, e.g. the author knows relatively little for markets other than equity markets.
